WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_examinations,
           COUNT(*) AS patient_count
    FROM patient_counts
), shares AS (
    SELECT pc.ID,
           pc.examination_count,
           1.0 * pc.examination_count / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total,
           1.0 / t.patient_count AS average_share
    FROM patient_counts AS pc
    CROSS JOIN totals AS t
)
SELECT ID,
       examination_count,
       share_of_total,
       share_of_total - average_share AS margin_above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share_of_total > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the total examinations divided equally across IDs that have at least one examination, since the share-by-patient breakdown groups examination records by ID.
